title: Bluetooth Score Console for Volleyball Scoreboard

information.value: Final year project - BTS Digital Systems
Bluetooth data transmission from the console / Development of an alternative mobile application using App Inventor
Physical console for real-time score management / Bluetooth transmission to a scoreboard / Mobile application as an alternative to the console / Display on giant LED matrices
PIC18F45K20 microcontroller / Bluetooth / Giant LED matrices for display / Mobile application developed with App Inventor

description: As part of my final year project in BTS Digital Systems in 2021, we designed a Bluetooth score console intended for a scoreboard for a volleyball team in Montpellier.

Our team consisted of three members, each with a specific role: I was responsible for the Bluetooth data transmission from the physical console, one colleague handled the reception and processing of data, and the last member worked on the score display on giant LED matrices.

The console, based on a PIC18F45K20 microcontroller, allowed real-time score management by sending data via Bluetooth to the scoreboard. This microcontroller was chosen for its data processing capabilities and features suitable for wireless communications.
To complement this setup, I developed a mobile application using App Inventor, allowing users to replace the physical console if needed, providing greater flexibility.
The project integrates giant LED matrices for optimal score visibility, even from a distance, along with a robust management system ensuring smooth and lag-free display.
This project strengthened my skills in wireless communication (Bluetooth), mobile application development, as well as electronic integration and teamwork on a technical project.
